about: Test design, graded by mutation: the agent's tests must pass on the real code and fail on four versions that each break one stacking rule.

engagement.title: Tally: pin down the discount rules

goals.title: Discount rules can't break silently
goals.objective: Any change that breaks a discount stacking rule fails a test.

todos.text: Write tests for src/discount.js that pin down every stacking rule in docs/discounts.md, so that a change breaking any one rule fails a test. Don't change src/.
